title.narrative: Utilizing Intelligent Technology to Transform Teaching and Learning Toward Smart Education

description.narrative: The project aims to promote inclusive and gender-sensitive quality education, boost the number of qualified educators, and improve employment-relevant skills through smart education. It provides education policymakers and practitioners with theoretical frameworks for developing, implementing, and overseeing smart education systems nationwide. Moreover, the project offers policy guidance on leveraging AI in education to optimize learning outcomes. Education policymakers also gain practical skills in monitoring and evaluating the progress of national smart education initiatives. Additionally, the project establishes benchmarks to measure the effectiveness of these initiatives and identifies areas for enhancement. Overall, it contributes to the advancement of education systems that are responsive to diverse needs and equipped for the future.
